name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted YouTube downloader that subscribes to channels and playlists, fetches new videos on a schedule with yt-dlp and writes metadata for Plex, Jellyfin, Emby and Kodi.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated AUTH_PRESET_PASSWORD from the environment settings. Youtarr reapplies these credentials on every restart, so change the password there and redeploy instead of changing it in the web UI.
